scripts.//prebuild: Next resolves @course-prod/core through its exports map, which points at dist/. Building core here — rather than relying on the caller passing `--filter @course-prod/web...` — means a bare `pnpm --filter @course-prod/web build` also works. Railway's Railpack builder emits exactly that command, and without this the build fails with 'Cannot resolve @course-prod/core/db'.
